note: Alexey research line for brackets. brackets_01 is the current best at 3,669,188 -- 2.04x better than brackets_00's 7,473,269. Pure geometry: same three machine rooms, trimmed of empty edges and re-placed.

variants.label: repacked: rooms stacked classify/close/open, pipes shortened
variants.architecture: Machine rooms used verbatim, only trimmed of provably empty edges (classify 19x20->19x18, close 10x32->9x30, open unchanged), then stacked vertically instead of classify-beside-open. Ports keep their offsets relative to each room, so nearest-pipe resolution inside the rooms is untouched. Room ORDER is what makes the routing planar: with close in the middle, one of the two cross-layout wraps becomes a two-row hop and only one long pipe remains, owning the east columns and the bottom row.
variants.verdict: TEAM BEST for brackets. Footprint 29% better AND ticks 28% better -- the tick gain was unplanned and comes from the long pipes shrinking. Remaining geometry headroom is small: height 42 binds against width 37, and the three inter-room gaps are already at their minimum of 2-3 rows each.
